data.narrative:
Tytan Technologies is a Series A-stage Defense & Security company that has raised €30M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 10 peers—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms in the same sector and stage, including Stark Defence, Castelion, Singularity, and NODA AI.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the €30M total raised as a proxy base and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, yielding €60M. Peer-median analysis examines four same-sector, same-stage comparables, which span a wide range from €125M (NODA AI) to €4.0B (Stark Defence), with a median valuation of €700M. This dispersion reflects meaningful variation in maturity and market position within the Defense & Security frontier-tech cohort.

The triangulated analysis across both methods supports a valuation range of €51M (floor) to €805M (ceiling), with a median of €380M. The wide spread between methods—driven primarily by the outsized valuation of Stark Defence and Castelion relative to earlier-stage peers—reflects material uncertainty around Tytan's competitive positioning and technology differentiation within the Defense & Security sector. The gap between stage-progression and peer-median estimates warrants closer examination of Tytan's traction metrics, IP defensibility, and customer pipeline relative to the peer sample.
